title: Subtraction
introduction: Explore subtraction through definitions, examples and practice.
definition: Subtraction finds the amount left after taking away a quantity, or the difference between two quantities.

formulas.description: a is the minuend, b is the subtrahend, c is the difference.
Subtracting zero leaves a number unchanged.

examples.question: Find 42 − 15. Regroup one ten as ten ones. Subtract 5 from 12, then 1 ten from 3 tens.

exercises.question: There are 23 apples. 8 are eaten. How many remain?

summary: Subtraction finds the amount left after taking away a quantity, or the difference between two quantities.
